ev.q: Unpublished estimates from the 2008 National Health Interview Survey.
In 2008, approximately 27% of adults participated in leisure-time strengthening activities
The percentage of men who engaged in leisure-time strengthening activities decreased with age
approximately 27% of adults participated in leisure-time strengthening activities
Among all age groups except those aged 65--74 years, men were more likely than women to engage in leisure-time strengthening activities.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
